item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["459a93f0538f947ff3c8"],"operation":"Dump a value returned by json_loadb through do_dump.","condition":"The loaded value reaches the new dump depth limit.","capability":"json_loadb and parse_json must admit a value that reaches the do_dump guard.","consequence":"Dumping returns failure at the depth limit.","equivalence_reason":"Singleton: this concerns depth-limit rejection during dumping."},{"member_ids":["2d961f56c0c65878aac3"],"operation":"Call json_dumps with nonzero JSON_MAX_INDENT flags.","condition":"Indentation flags are supported, but the harness clears JSON_MAX_INDENT before calling json_dumps.","capability":"json_dumps must receive the indentation flags and pass them through do_dump to dump_indent.","consequence":"Indented string output is unreachable through that harness call.","equivalence_reason":"Singleton: this concerns indentation flags and formatted output, not depth-limit rejection."}]}
